note: Scripture authority for Amharic is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref) — founder decision 2026-11-18, replacing the 1962 UBS text this sermon first quoted.

A `mined` row means the quotation is a verbatim contiguous span of OWB Amharic Balanced (a whole verse, a range joined with a space, or the shortest span that carries the clause Booth quotes), spliced by script. Acts 26:17 at block 20 is prefixed by Booth's own "I will be with thee" (not in the verse in any text); the verse words after it are verbatim OWB.
`self_rendered` rows are allusions in Booth's own voice, not quotations: John 3:16 (block 3) and Psalm 119:136 (block 15, the David image, aligned to OWB's "stream of water" wording of block 1).
